drhp.business: Oriana Power (TrueRE) develops and delivers solar projects across utility-scale, commercial & industrial and specialised applications through EPC and IPP models, covering rooftop, ground-mounted, floating, carport and agri-photovoltaic solar. It also executes battery energy storage (BESS) and hybrid solar-wind-storage projects for round-the-clock power, and is developing green hydrogen, green ammonia, e-methanol and compressed biogas under a Generation > Storage > Consumption platform.

risks.note: Evolving regulations, policy changes and revisions to incentive frameworks in renewable energy can change project economics, operations and financial performance.

Growth requires adequate liquidity and access to capital; funding constraints or working-capital pressure could hurt performance. Borrowings rose during the year for project execution, working capital and investments in subsidiaries and project SPVs, and finance costs grew faster than EBIT.
Supply-chain disruptions, cost escalations, resource constraints or execution challenges can delay projects and hit customer satisfaction and margins.

Rapid technology change, shifting customer preferences, competitive intensity and pricing pressure can affect demand and profitability; the company does not manufacture and relies on a technology-agnostic approach.
Global trade disruptions, geopolitical developments and policy changes can affect the availability and cost of critical components; mitigated through diversified sourcing and Make in India.
risks.risk: Geopolitical and supply-chain risk for critical components

risks.note: Dependence on advanced solar technologies exposes the business to product quality, equipment performance and obsolescence risks.

Climate-related events, evolving environmental regulations and natural disasters can affect project performance and operational continuity.

sk.overview: Powerica operates across two industries: (1) India's standby power / diesel-generator (DG set) market, where DG sets, UPS, inverters and battery storage provide backup power during outages/voltage fluctuations across commercial, manufacturing, IT/data-centre, telecom and infrastructure sectors (F&S Report); and (2) India's wind power sector within the broader renewable energy industry, where wind plays a pivotal role in the country's energy transition (CRISIL Report).

sk.structure: DG sets classified by capacity: LHP (7.5-160 kVA), MHP (180-500 kVA), HHP (>500 kVA); MSLG sets 3-10 MW for continuous/base-load. Wind potential concentrated in five states: Rajasthan (24%), Gujarat (16%), Maharashtra (15%), Karnataka (15%), Andhra Pradesh (11%).

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- customer lock-in: long-term contracted green ammonia offtake — evidence: signed a 10-year binding Green Ammonia Purchase Agreement (GAPA) with SECI for 60,000 TPA valued at ~₹3,135 crore [planned]
- licence/regulatory: grid access in a grid-constrained industry — evidence: the Company expanded its Open Access grid connectivity across Rajasthan, Haryana, and Tamil Nadu, while the MD&A names grid connectivity and renewable energy evacuation as industry execution challenges

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Evolving regulations, policy changes and revisions to incentive frameworks in renewable energy can change project economics, operations and financial performance.
- Growth requires adequate liquidity and access to capital; funding constraints or working-capital pressure could hurt performance. Borrowings rose during the year for project execution, working capital and investments in subsidiaries and project SPVs, and finance costs grew faster than EBIT.
- Supply-chain disruptions, cost escalations, resource constraints or execution challenges can delay projects and hit customer satisfaction and margins.
- Rapid technology change, shifting customer preferences, competitive intensity and pricing pressure can affect demand and profitability; the company does not manufacture and relies on a technology-agnostic approach.
- Global trade disruptions, geopolitical developments and policy changes can affect the availability and cost of critical components; mitigated through diversified sourcing and Make in India.
- Dependence on advanced solar technologies exposes the business to product quality, equipment performance and obsolescence risks.
- Equipment failure, cyber threats, system downtime or natural events can disrupt operations; mitigated through SCADA real-time monitoring and preventive maintenance.
- Climate-related events, evolving environmental regulations and natural disasters can affect project performance and operational continuity.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Flywheel model: develop high-quality, bankable assets, selectively monetise them to recycle capital, strengthen the balance sheet and redeploy capital into new opportunities.

- Scale BESS across C&I hybrid projects, the merchant market and utility-scale storage through disciplined project selection.
